q: Very few cars are as luxurious as Rolls-Royce. (Make it Comparative)
o: Rolls-Royce is more luxurious than any other cars.
Rolls-Royce is more luxurious than other cars.
Rolls-Royce is more luxurious than most other cars.
Rolls-Royce is more luxurious than more other cars.

q: He is only six. (Make it Negative)
o: He is not less than six.

q: Transform the following complex sentence into a compound sentence: Although the task was difficult, he completed it on time.
o: The task was difficult, so he completed it on time.
The task was difficult, but he completed it on time.
The task was difficult, and he completed it on time.
The task was difficult, therefore he completed it on time.

q: Despite being sick, Hasiba went to the office. (Complex)
o: Though Hasiba was sick, she went to the office.
Hasiba was sick that she went to the office.
As though Hasiba was sick that she went to the office.
Though Hasiba was sick that she went to the office.

q: Karim is as diligent as Rahim. (Transform into Comparative Degree)
o: Karim is more diligent as Rahim.
Rahim is not more diligent than Karim.
Rahim is less diligent than Karim.
Karim is more diligent than Rahim.

q: An Imperative sentence usually expresses —
Cultivate a habit of continuous learning. What kind of sentence is this?
Stop crying and do something about it. This is an example of -
There is no king in China, _________________?
Salman hardly ever goes out, ______?
Let's solve the problem together, __________? (Tag question)
He is too poor to pay the rent. (Make it Complex).
o: He is so poor that he can not pay the rent.
He is very poor and can not pay the rent.
He has no money to pay the rent.
He is not rich and can not pay the rent.

q: ‘Move or you will die' This is a -
Ronaldo is the best footballer we have ever seen. (make it comparative)
o: Ronaldo is better than any other footballer we have ever seen.
Ronaldo is better than most other footballer we have ever seen.
Ronaldo is better footballer than any other we have ever seen.
Ronaldo is better than other footballer we have ever seen.
e: Superlative degree থেকে comparative বানাতে the বাদ যায়, superlative-এর জায়গায় comparative রূপ বসে এবং than any other যুক্ত হয়। তাই best বদলে better than any other footballer হয়। বাক্যে of all থাকলে তার জায়গায় than all other বসে। শুদ্ধ রূপ: Ronaldo is better than any other footballer we have ever seen।

q: Once upon a time, there was an old mariner . The underlined part is a/an-
Having finished his homework, he went out to play.(Make it Compound)
o: He has finished his homework and gone out to play.
After finishing his homework, he went out to play.
He had finished his homework and went out to play.
Being finished his homework, he went out to play.

q: 'I greeted my aunt as I passed through the kitchen' is an example of __________ sentence.
Move and die. (simple)
o: If you move, you will die.
If you do not move, you will die.

q: He rarely goes to the recreation center, _______________?
In spite of his having riches, he leads a poor life. The complex form of the sentence is –
o: Although he was riches, he leads a poor life.
Although he has been riches, he leads a poor life.
Although he had riches, he lead a poor life.
Although he has riches, he leads a poor life.
